headline: Trump closes rally with YMCA dance

beats.text: Even after ninety minutes of grievances, Trump still had energy left for one final tradition.
His hundred-days victory lap in Warren, Michigan ended the same way it always does: shoulders swaying, fists pumping, the loudspeakers doing all the work.
The crowd didn't need convincing. They sang along and threw their own fists in the air right with him.

beats.caption: (making a heart shape with her hands, no spoken words)
beats.label: via FOX 9 Minneapolis-St. Paul

beats.text: Then, right on cue, he pointed back at the crowd one last time and vanished behind the curtain, the most reliable part of any Trump rally.
